from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Captures financial metrics for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the listed company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock ticker code for unique identification")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, format YYYY-MM")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets in yuan")
    equity_attributable: float | None = Field(description="Equity attributable to shareholders in yuan")
    roe_weighted_avg: float | None = Field(description="Weighted Average Return on Net Assets in percent")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
